f.statement: Where it concerns the interests of the European Union, ZVA and the MAH are entitled to refer a matter to the EMA CHMP or PRAC under the registration rules.

rows.deadline: Renewal decision or 21 July 2015, whichever is earlier
rows.quote: Šo noteikumu 15.5.apakšpunktā minētā prasība zāļu reģistrācijas īpašniekam uzturēt un pēc pieprasījuma darīt pieejamu farmakovigilances sistēmas pamatlietu par vienām vai vairākām zālēm, par kurām pieņemts lēmums par zāļu reģistrāciju pirms 2012.gada 21.jūlija, piemērojama ar dienu, kad pieņemts lēmums par zāļu pārreģistrāciju, vai ar 2015.gada 21.jūliju (atkarībā no tā, kurš datums ir agrāks).
rows.review_note: National (Latvia) Cabinet Regulation No 47 of 22 January 2013 (consolidated with amendments No 10/2014 and No 590/2014): national transposition of Directive 2010/84/EU and 2012/26/EU plus national additions (national contact person, 15-day information to ZVA, parallel importer duties); marked national. rows.quote_en: The requirement referred to in sub-paragraph 15.5 of these Regulations for the marketing authorisation holder to maintain and make available on request the pharmacovigilance system master file for one or more medicinal products for which the registration decision was taken before 21 July 2012 applies from the date of the decision on re-registration of the medicinal product or from 21 July 2015 (whichever date is earlier).

deadline_rule.applies_to: PSMF for authorisations granted before 21 July 2012 (latest date)

f.title: Apply Chapter VII PASS rules only to studies started after 21 July 2012
f.statement: Chapter VII (post-authorisation safety studies) applies to studies started after 21 July 2012.

rows.quote: Šo noteikumu VII nodaļu piemēro tiem pēcreģistrācijas pētījumiem, kas sākti pēc 2012.gada 21.jūlija.
rows.review_note: National (Latvia) Cabinet Regulation No 47 of 22 January 2013 (consolidated with amendments No 10/2014 and No 590/2014): national transposition of Directive 2010/84/EU and 2012/26/EU plus national additions (national contact person, 15-day information to ZVA, parallel importer duties); marked national. Review: OK. Double-check: OK.
rows.quote_en: Chapter VII of these Regulations applies to post-authorisation studies started after 21 July 2012.

f.title: Until EudraVigilance is fully functional: serious Latvian ADRs to ZVA within 15 days, third-country to EMA
f.statement: Until EMA ensures full EudraVigilance functionality, the MAH reports all serious suspected adverse reactions found in Latvia to ZVA no later than 15 days after receiving the information, and all suspected adverse reactions found in third countries to EMA.
f.applicability: Transitional period before full EudraVigilance functionality

rows.deadline: No later than 15 days after receipt of information
rows.quote: Līdz laikam, kad Eiropas Zāļu aģentūra sāk nodrošināt Eudravigilance datubāzes pilnīgu darbību, par visām būtiskajām iespējamām zāļu blakusparādībām, kas konstatētas Latvijas teritorijā, zāļu reģistrācijas īpašnieks ne vēlāk kā 15 dienu laikā pēc informācijas saņemšanas ziņo Zāļu valsts aģentūrai,
rows.review_note: National (Latvia) Cabinet Regulation No 47 of 22 January 2013 (consolidated with amendments No 10/2014 and No 590/2014): national transposition of Directive 2010/84/EU and 2012/26/EU plus national additions (national contact person, 15-day information to ZVA, parallel importer duties); marked national. Review: historic transitional rule (EV centralised since 22 Nov 2017). Double-check: OK.
rows.quote_en: Until the European Medicines Agency begins to ensure full operation of the Eudravigilance database, the marketing authorisation holder reports all serious suspected adverse reactions found in the territory of Latvia to the State Agency of Medicines no later than within 15 days after receipt of the information,

deadline_rule.clock_start: pēc informācijas saņemšanas ziņo Zāļu valsts aģentūrai

f.title: Until the PSUR repository functions, submit PSURs to ZVA for products authorised in Latvia
f.statement: Until EMA ensures coordinated operation of the PSUR repository, the MAH submits PSURs to ZVA if the product is authorised in Latvia.
f.applicability: Transitional period before the PSUR repository

rows.quote: Līdz laikam, kad Eiropas Zāļu aģentūra sāk nodrošināt periodisko ziņojumu repozitorija saskaņoto darbību, zāļu reģistrācijas īpašnieks periodiskos ziņojumus iesniedz Zāļu valsts aģentūrā, ja zāles ir reģistrētas Latvijā.

rows.quote_en: Until the European Medicines Agency begins to ensure coordinated operation of the periodic report repository, the marketing authorisation holder submits periodic reports to the State Agency of Medicines if the medicinal product is registered in Latvia.

dates.title: Latvia Cabinet Regulation No 47 (pharmacovigilance procedure): enters into force
dates.scope: MAHs, parallel importers and distributors, healthcare professionals and ZVA (human medicinal products)
dates.timing_note: Date from the likumi.lv legal act passport; published in Latvijas Vēstnesis No 22, 31.01.2013.

dates.title: MK 47: national PV contact person must live and work in Latvia
dates.scope: MAHs whose QPPV does not live and work in Latvia (national-level contact person, sub-paragraph 15.4)
dates.quote: Šo noteikumu 15.4. apakšpunktā minētā prasība nacionāla līmeņa kontaktpersonai dzīvot un strādāt Latvijā stājas spēkā 2015. gada 1. jūlijā
dates.quote_en: The requirement in sub-paragraph 15.4 of these Regulations for the national-level contact person to live and work in Latvia enters into force on 1 July 2015
dates.timing_note: Added by Cabinet Regulation No 590 of 30.09.2014.

dates.title: MK 47: PSMF obligation applies at the latest for pre-July 2012 authorisations
dates.scope: MAHs of products authorised before 21 July 2012 (earlier if re-registered)
dates.quote: piemērojama ar dienu, kad pieņemts lēmums par zāļu pārreģistrāciju, vai ar 2015.gada 21.jūliju (atkarībā no tā, kurš datums ir agrāks).
dates.quote_en: applies from the date of the decision on re-registration or from 21 July 2015 (whichever is earlier).
